summary: Executed focused acceptance run from brief: reviewed 19-gate regression suites, added isolated auth suite, added real-source Beso evidence tests, and performed readonly preview UI verification on desktop/mobile. Core reviewed suites passed after setting disposable test Mongo URL; isolated auth exposed seed_super_admin password-update defect; optional safe pack/ledger/tax suites show multiple regressions.

critical.issue: Existing super admin password is not updated when SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD changes (isolated auth test fails: check_pw(new_password, stored_hash) == False).

minor.issue: Pack/scanner tests fail due aggregate cursor contract mismatch: '_Agg' missing batch_size in test double path.
VAT basis behavior diverges from expected hidden-from-storefront and unknown-tax gross-up paths in safe regression tests.
Safe ledger phase-2 test expects sealed_ksa_window usage but current implementation delegates directly to store_views.ranking().

ui_bugs.issue: Detail sheet shows 'Price Range - SAR' and empty 'Market Avg SAR' (no numeric value); own-price specific intel testid not present in rendered panel.

integration_issues.issue: PASS: selecting Aleef emits API request with store_id query param.

issues: No blocking layout/contrast defects found in sampled screens; mobile 390x844 and desktop 1920x800 render without overflow blockers in tested views.

action_items: Fix seed_super_admin to rotate password hash for existing super admin when SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD changes.
Investigate stale/null own price rendering for Beso SKU detail panel where '- SAR' appears instead of numeric own/market values.
Address regressions flagged by safe suites: pack guard matching, scanner aggregate cursor contract, ledger window expectation, VAT hidden/unknown basis paths.
critical_code_review_comments: seed_super_admin pops password_hash from update payload on existing users, preventing password rotation by env change.
Auth controls validated in isolated suite: bcrypt '$2b$' hashes, httpOnly auth cookie, explicit-origin CORS with credentials, and brute-force lockout after 5 failures are working.
Real-source evidence from captured files confirms Beso values used in tests: own 79.35 (SKU 8699245859829), Zarafa 83.95, Petsy 87.0.
seed_data_creation: Created disposable isolated auth users and disposable DB names during test execution only; auto-dropped at teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core reviewed regression files passed when DALEEL_TEST_MONGO_URL is set to mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017. Isolated auth suite is in test_findings_auth_isolated.py and currently fails only seed_super_admin password-rotation assertion. Preview UI evidence: My Products search for 8699245859829 works; detail panel shows '- SAR'; Market Share selected competitor sends store_id API param; Scanner evidence/empty-state visible on desktop and mobile.
rca of the issue: RCA (seed_super_admin): existing admin path removes password_hash from update payload, so env password changes never re-hash/update persisted password; reproduction in isolated suite inserts legacy hash then runs seed_super_admin, stored hash remains old. Mitigation: compare existing hash with SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD using check_pw and set password_hash=hash_pw(...) when mismatch.
